results.description:
I'm officially throwing my hat in the ring entering #NEARhackathon with NEAR Hunt - the Product Hunt for NEAR

NEAR Hunt is the place to discover ALL hackathon submissions (2200+), have discussion and upvote.

Cool features:
- Authenticate with your Near.social profile
- Claim project with Github OAuth
- Give a skill.md file to your agent ;)
- Open Data: no smart contracts(!). Just Key-value rows on a NEAR account calling fast data_kv

Live now: https://nearhunt.xyz
Repo: https://github.com/satojandro/near-hunt
